en: Wattson
Oh, {player}! You're just the one I wanted. I've a favour to ask of a trainer of your spark!
Under the Cycling Road lies New Mauville, a power plant I built. Its generator has run wild and won't settle down.
Would you go and switch it off for me? Here, this is the key to its door.
Don't you worry about it. Surf along Route 110 under the Cycling Road and you'll come to its door. Wahahaha!
Wahahahaha! You switched it off! I knew I could count on you, {player}!
Here, take this as my thanks. It holds Thunderbolt, a move with a jolt to it!
Wahahaha! Seeing young people take charge like you makes an old man like me feel bright as a bulb!
Wally
text: Wally

en: Uncle, please! I want to challenge the Gym. I know Ralts and I can do it!
text: Unchiule, te rog! Vreau să provoc Arena. Știu că Ralts și cu mine putem!

en: Wally's Uncle
text: Unchiul lui Wally

en: Now, Wally, you've only just got here. Don't you think you're pushing yourself?
text: Wally, abia ai ajuns aici. Nu crezi că te forțezi prea tare?

en: Wally
text: Wally

en: But we've been training! We can beat anyone!
text: Dar ne-am antrenat! Putem să-i batem pe toți!

en: {player}! You came at just the right time. Will you battle me? If I win, my uncle will see how strong I am!
text: {player}! Ai venit exact la timp. Te lupți cu mine? Dacă înving, unchiul meu o să vadă cât de puternic sunt!

en: Wally
text: Wally

en: {player}... Please, will you battle me? I have to show my uncle!
text: {player}... Te rog, te lupți cu mine? Trebuie să-i arăt unchiului meu!

en: Battle Wally?
text: Te lupți cu Wally?

en: Wally
text: Wally

en: Thank you! Ralts, here we go!
text: Mulțumesc! Ralts, să mergem!

en: Wally
text: Wally

en: I... I lost. You really are strong, {player}.
text: Am... am pierdut. Chiar ai forță, {player}.

en: Uncle... I'll go back to Verdanturf with you. I'm not ready for the Gym yet.
text: Unchiule... Mă întorc cu tine în Verdanturf. Încă nu sunt pregătit pentru Arenă.

en: {player}, thank you. Battling you showed me how much further I have to go.
text: {player}, mulțumesc. Lupta cu tine mi-a arătat cât de mult mai am de mers.

en: Wally's Uncle
text: Unchiul lui Wally

en: Don't be down, Wally. You battled well, and you'll only get stronger. Come visit us in Verdanturf, {player}!
text: Nu fi trist, Wally. Te-ai luptat bine și vei deveni tot mai puternic. Vino să ne vizitezi în Verdanturf, {player}!

en: Wally
text: Wally

en: Oh... Then my uncle will never believe I'm strong enough.
text: Oh... Atunci unchiul meu n-o să creadă niciodată că sunt destul de puternic.

en: Scott
text: Scott

en: I watched the whole thing. You didn't hold back against him, did you? That's how it should be!
text: Am văzut totul. Nu te-ai menajat deloc cu el, nu? Așa și trebuie!

en: That boy will grow strong too, I can tell. Well, see you around!
text: Băiatul ăsta o să devină și el puternic, se vede. Ei, ne mai vedem!

en: Wally's Uncle
text: Unchiul lui Wally

en: Wally's been so full of energy since he caught his Ralts. It's wonderful, but I do worry about him.
text: Wally e plin de energie de când și-a prins Ralts-ul. E minunat, dar îmi fac griji pentru el.

en: Could you battle Wally for me? He won't listen to me, but losing to you might teach him patience.
text: Te-ai lupta cu Wally pentru mine? Pe mine nu mă ascultă, dar o înfrângere cu tine l-ar putea învăța răbdarea.

en: Boy
text: Băiatul

en: Have you seen the television in the Pokémon Center? The shows change all the time, so check it often!
text: Ai văzut televizorul din Centrul Pokémon? Emisiunile se schimbă mereu, așa că uită-te des!

en: I've been watching all the shows. There's always something new on!
text: M-am uitat la toate emisiunile. Mereu e ceva nou!
